message: The other day, I caught my kids turning our living room into a fort with couch cushions and blankets. As I watched them laugh and create their own little world, I couldn’t help but think about how we often overlook the importance of play in family preparedness. While I’m busy thinking about go-bags and emergency plans, they’re reminding me that having a little fun and creativity can be part of our readiness, too. So, I decided to turn our fort into a ‘safety zone’ where we could chat about what to do in an emergency. Who knew a fortress could lead to such a valuable conversation? What are your favorite ways to combine fun and preparedness with your kids? 😊
